upstream.name: Institutional lending — borrower credit and collateral enforcement
upstream.note: October21 statements distinguish Anchorage loan principal from custody and FalconX principal from pledged security; subletters are not additional independent reserves. The November17 public lending feed reports anonymous and named groups, not a complete identified loan/legal book. Provider roles and loans are not assumed independent; collateral control, default status and recoverable proceeds remain unknown.

upstream.name: Basis trade — BTC/ETH perpetual shorts
upstream.note: Crypto/noncrypto hedging and CEX/OES settlement introduce venue, PnL and execution dependencies. Older Q1 and October custody-location percentages are historical and are not current derivatives notional or backing weights. Current hedge matching and complete composition remain unverified.

upstream.name: Chaos Labs Edge Proof of Reserves
upstream.note: External transparency tooling depends on off-chain provider/issuer inputs. Neither a historical backing percentage nor display availability establishes independent current custody, title or complete reserve assurance.

dependencies.upstream_resolution_rule: ⚠️ EVERY upstream entry carries exactly one resolution: `slug` / `slugs` / `terminal`+`kind` / `unresolved`. TERMINAL means nothing is missing; UNRESOLVED means a report is owed. Never merged.
dependencies.edge_kind_rule: `backing` = my SOLVENCY depends on it. `venue` = my EXIT PRICE does.
dependencies.coverage_note: October21 documentary snapshot, published November6 and reviewed November23, discloses 12 EVM and two Solana addresses. Roster disclosure does not establish present tracking, ownership or asset weights; the accepted offline replay deliberately omits wallet collection and marks all14 accounts untracked. Current composition, hedge notional, beneficial-owner overlap and recoverable collateral remain unverified. The November17 lending feed has its own scope/clock; no current total-backing weights are inferred. Generated downstream relationships do not determine the grade.

downstream_basis.asserted_only_note: None — every asserted edge is reproducible from an upstream array.
downstream_basis.do_not_hand_edit: ⚠️ downstream_tracked is GENERATED. Hand-maintaining both directions is how fxsave came to list fxUSD as BOTH its upstream and its downstream — one edge recorded twice, in opposite directions. Add the edge to the UPSTREAM array of the dependent asset and re-run build.
